outcome: Success rate of cervical inversion in controlling PPH
Time to completion of cervical inversion
cohort: 10 women who underwent cervical inversion for PPH management during cesarean delivery for placenta previa accreta/increta at a center in Zahedan, Iran, between July 2, 2011, and September 25, 2014
finding: Cervical inversion was found to be a successful procedure for managing PPH in all 10 cases, with bleeding controlled within 3-5 minutes and no reported complications.
mod_finding: This study describes the use of cervical inversion for postpartum hemorrhage management specifically during cesarean deliveries for placenta previa accreta/increta.
